instruction.text: Decide whether the question is a statistical question or not.

wrong.text: This is a non-statistical question because there cannot be a variety of answers. The capital of Japan is always Tokyo.

instruction.text: Why is this not a statistical question? Select the correct answer.

b: This is not a statistical question because statistical questions always contain numbers.
++This question would not be answered by collecting data that varies. There is only one correct answer.

instruction.text: Decide whether the question is a statistical question or not.

atoms.a: How many hours do year 7s spend on their homework per week?

wrong.text: This question would be answered by collecting data from multiple year 7s, and there would be variability in that data.

atoms.a: On average, how old are the teachers at your school?

wrong.text: To answer this question, you would collect data by asking the teachers at your school how old they are, and there would be variability in the data.

atoms.a: How many days are in December?

wrong.text: This question would not be answered by collecting varying data. The month of December always has 31 days.

atoms.a: How old is the current Prime Minister of the United Kingdom?

wrong.text: The current Prime Minister can only have one age at the moment the question is being asked. There is no varying data.

atoms.a: How much money do nurses make a year?

wrong.text: To answer this question, you would collect data by asking multiple nurses how much money they make.

atoms.a: How many siblings do you have?

wrong.text: There is only one answer to this question because only a single person is being asked.

atoms.a: Are the year 8s at your school taller than the year 7s?

wrong.text: To answer this question, you would collect varying data by measuring both year 8s and year 7s in order to determine which year is taller on average.

atoms.a: What social media platform is the most popular among teenagers?

wrong.text: You would have to ask multiple teenagers what their favourite platform is. So, this question would be answered by collecting data that varies.

atoms.a: In what year did author Toni Morrison receive the Nobel Prize for Literature?

wrong.text: To answer this question, no varying data needs to be collected. There is only one correct answer.

atoms.a: Does it rain more during spring or autumn?

wrong.text: To answer this question, you would collect varying data by checking and comparing the amount of rain that has fallen in spring and autumn.
